waypoints.advice: 58 km in you reach Signal de Botrange. The road climbs 694 m over the 29 km before it, steadily. Reckon on about 5 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is La Roche en Ardenne, 30 km on and mostly downhill.

scenicChapters.narrative: For 26 km this is Belgian Ardennes Scenic Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Belgian Ardennes Scenic Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 16 km. 694 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Signal de Botrange → La Roche en Ardenne
scenicChapters.narrative: 51 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

scenicChapters.title: Béguinage de Diest → Voormalig Stadhuis / Lakenhal
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 36 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: Belgian Ardennes Scenic Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 28 km this is Belgian Ardennes Scenic Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
